art.name: Blue Lift Column
art.idea: A workshop seen at dusk, true to the Mrak name: a deep blue-black page where the work is lit like under an inspection lamp, held up by one blue column taken from the lift that holds the cars.
art.typeCharacter: Archivo is used as plain, sturdy workshop lettering. The h1 is Archivo ExtraBold at about 7vw in sentence case with tight leading. Section heads are Archivo Bold at 44 to 56px. Body text is Archivo Regular at 18px in #e9edf0. The phone is Archivo Black set as a huge numeral. There is no uppercase tracking anywhere.
art.composition: The page is a 12-column grid on a deep #0f1419 ground. A solid #1f4fd1 vertical field always fills column 9 in every section, so the sections stack into one continuous lift post. HERO: columns 1 to 6 hold the h1 low in the frame, with the lead below it and one square-cornered blue button (Pokličite). The lift photo bleeds from column 7 to the right edge across the full hero height. The blue post at column 9 runs behind the photo's top and bottom edges and shows above and below it. SERVICES: a full-width #1f4fd1 band. The heading sits in columns 1 to 5, and the offerings run as a two-column ruled list in columns 6 to 12 with thin #f1f4f8 rules. Each item is one line, with the short notes in lighter weight. STEPS: dark ground. The mechanic photo, cropped to the lamp, hands and engine only, fills columns 1 to 5 with a cut top-right corner. Columns 6 to 12 hold the heading and two large ruled rows: predračun, then popravilo. STORY: a #1a222a surface field. The heading and text sit in columns 1 to 6, and the tyre rack photo bleeds to the right edge from column 8. The blue post shows at column 9 above the photo. CONTACT: dark ground. The address and directions sit in columns 1 to 4, a simple line map in #2d3843 and #9ba7b2 with one #d9342b dot sits in columns 5 to 8, the blue post sits in column 9, and the phone as a giant numeral plus an hours week strip sit in columns 10 to 12. A thin footer follows.
art.imagery: Only the client's three photos are used, all in full colour and never tinted. img_01 (the car on the blue lift, with the red tool cart) is the hero and is cropped so the blue lift column and the raised car dominate. img_02 is cropped tightly to the inspection lamp, the hand on the fender and the engine bay, with no face visible. img_03 (the tyre rack) appears in the story section. There is no drawn art. The only non-photo graphic is the schematic map line drawing, with a single red #d9342b dot marking the workshop, which is the page's one red accent.
art.signature: A solid lift-blue column sits at the same grid position in every section and stacks into one unbroken post down the dark page, the same blue as the lift in the client's hero photo.

art.imagePrompt: A flat full-page screenshot of a desktop homepage at 1536x1024 px, with no browser window, no device frame and no perspective. The site is a car-repair workshop. The page ground is a deep blue-black #0f1419, with text in #e9edf0 and muted text in #9ba7b2. All type is Archivo: the headline in ExtraBold, large, sentence case and tightly leaded, and body text in Archivo Regular. A 12-column grid runs throughout. A solid vertical field of lift blue #1f4fd1, exactly one column wide at column 9, appears at the same position in every section, so that stacked down the page it reads as one continuous blue lift post. HERO, about 620px tall: on the left, columns 1 to 6, the big headline sits in the lower half, with a short lead under it and a single square-cornered solid #1f4fd1 button with #f1f4f8 text (no pill shape). On the right, from column 7 to the right page edge, is the attached photo of the grey estate car raised on a blue two-post lift, with the red tool cart visible, cropped tall so the blue lift column is prominent. The blue column-9 post shows above and below the photo. A thin top bar holds the text wordmark on the left and small nav links on the right; there is no logo image. NEXT SECTION, beginning at the bottom of the frame: a full-width band of #1f4fd1. On the left is a heading in #f1f4f8 Archivo Bold. On the right is a two-column list of workshop services separated by thin light horizontal rules, plain text with no icons and no cards. Beneath this, if visible, is a dark section with the attached mechanic photo cropped tightly to the lit inspection lamp, the hand and the engine bay, with no face shown and a cut top-right corner, in columns 1 to 5. Two large ruled step rows sit to its right. The overall feel is dark, calm and solid, like a workshop at dusk with the work lit by a lamp. The only accent colour is one small red #d9342b detail. There are no gradients, no shadows, no rounded cards, no icons, no emoji, no numbered labels, no centred layout and no extra invented photos.
